coverage_note: Deck anatomy and the choice structure were readable; the final multiplication was past the cut. The formula 13 x C(4,3) x 12 x C(4,2) = 3744 was recomputed and brute-forced over all 2,598,960 hands.
concepts: A hand is an unordered collection, so every choice is a combination.
Full house = 3 of one value + 2 of another: choose the tripled value (13), its suits C(4,3), then the paired value (12, not 13), then its suits C(4,2).
Trap: using 13 for both values, or forgetting the suit factors.
